## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change. Link the issue (`Closes #...`).

## Verification

Describe relevant tests and include results from `pnpm check`.

## Compatibility and security

Describe breaking changes, migration steps, new permissions or dependency changes. Use `None` if inapplicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused change with relevant tests and documentation
- [ ] Conventional Commit title and commits
- [ ] Breaking changes identified with `!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer when applicable
- [ ] No secrets or private data included
- [ ] Code of conduct and contribution guidelines followed
